content.instructions: Say a price with euros and cents: “4,50 €” is “vier Euro fünfzig”. After a quantity word the noun has no article and no plural: “ein Glas Wasser, eine Tasse Kaffee, ein Stück Kuchen”. The numbers 21 to 100 are in unit 1.
